claim: The byte printed `Sens` on an enhancer adds energy at the top of the spectrum along one curve on both enhancer types walked at five settings: over setting 0, the 12500 Hz band rises 8.1, 12.5, 15.3, 17.4 dB at 32, 64, 95, 127 on 01 02 and 8.0, 12.5, 15.3, 17.5 on 04 06, agreeing to 0.07 dB. Carried to the three enhancers walked at two settings it predicts 02 08 to 0.03 dB, and falls 0.29 to 0.36 dB short of 02 06 and 02 07, whose enhancer feeds a chorus or a flanger. For a byte that swings a modulator, zero stops the swing on every type asked at zero, but no law is set: the tremolo, the only such type read as a size at more than two settings, is not proportional to its byte, and on the three delay types a fitted swing came back at 0, 0 and 1 settings of five.

adds: The records give, per take, a band profile, a delay swing where a comb fit was admitted, a floor read off the phase and a level swing. What is read out of them here is that the two enhancers are one curve in their sensitivity byte, how far that curve carries to the others, that the bottom setting of a modulator's depth is off, and that neither swing read as a size is proportional to its byte. The records name no enhancer, no curve and no law.

at_zero.01 24: the phase stood over the part routed past the effect in 0 of 3 takes
at_zero.01 43: the phase stood over the part routed past the effect in 0 of 3 takes
at_zero.01 41: the only line stands at 3.05 Hz, where every other setting reads 0.44 to 0.45 Hz
at_zero.04 02: the only line stands at 3.64 Hz against 0.43 at 64, and 3.63, 3.64 Hz is what 04 01 returns at both of its settings with its chorus mixed out
at_zero.01 25: no take carries a line at the 2.50 Hz every other setting reads; 2 of 3 carry one at 4.80, 4.80 Hz instead

tremolo.why: Medians of three takes; the line through zero is the least-squares one over every non-zero setting.

enhancer_sensitivity.why: The top band of each profile, which is where the enhancer puts what it adds; medians of three takes, each setting against the same type's setting zero. A two-setting type is predicted by the change the law types' shared curve makes between the same two settings, interpolated in straight pieces.

why_about_names_two_types: The law is the enhancer's and was set on these two. The other types cited are where it was carried, and where the swing bytes were read and no law was set.

alternatives.reading: The enhancers of 02 06 and 02 07 run on the same curve, and their shortfall is the chorus or flanger after them shaping the top band rather than a different enhancer.

separated_by.observable: 02 06's sensitivity byte at 32 and 64 with its chorus balance (40 03 0C) written to 0, so the enhancer is heard without the chorus.

predicts.the same enhancer: the top band rises 4.44 dB from 32 to 64
predicts.a different enhancer: it rises 4.08 dB, as it did through the chorus

separated_by.sensitivity_here: The widest spread of three takes of one setting in that band on the law types, 0.10 dB.

alternatives.reading: A delay swing runs on a law in its depth byte, which 02 06 would show.

separated_by.observable: 02 06's fitted delay swing at settings 16, 32, 76, 127 of its depth byte, where it was fitted at 51 and 101 on one modulator at 0.45 Hz.
separated_by.divergence: 0.58 ms at 16. Both pass through the two readings already on disk by construction, so they part only where the byte was not asked.
separated_by.sensitivity_here: The spread of that record's own repeats of one setting, 0.3745 ms, the widest any repeated setting showed there.

alternatives.reading: A delay swing is proportional to its depth byte.
alternatives.ruled_out_by: 02 06 is the one two-setting type fitted at both settings on one modulator. From 3.98 ms at 51, proportional puts 7.89 ms at 101; the takes return 9.11, against a repeat spread of 0.3745 ms. Two points refute a law and cannot set one.

alternatives.reading: The tremolo's swing is proportional to its byte, read in one of the two domains the stage publishes.
alternatives.ruled_out_by: The least-squares line through zero over the four non-zero settings misses setting 32 by 0.185 of the mean, where its three takes spread 0.020; read in decibels it misses setting 96 by 3.20 dB where they spread 0.17. The swing is under the line at the bottom and over it at the top in both.

refuted_by: An enhancer's sensitivity byte walked at a setting between those asked here putting its top band off the shared curve by more than the repeats, on either law type; or a depth byte asked at zero returning a swing at its own modulator's rate.
